A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the spectral functions of hadronic channels show significant modifications at finite temperatures, but the changes in the spectral weights are not as drastic as expected from a hadron gas picture.

the lattice QCD results on the spectral functions of hadronic correlators are in agreement with the expectations from the hadron resonance gas model, and that the spectral functions of vector and axial-vector currents are consistent with the results from the hadron gas model.

the thermal dilepton rates obtained in lattice QCD are compatible with those extracted from experimental data.
